description: [Token Risk Oracle] Free, public, no signup — Free, public, no signup. Aggregates real on-chain risk signals from GoPlus Security for a token contract — honeypot detection, mint/ownership authority, holder & LP concentration, buy/sell tax, trust-list status — into one transparent risk score. Never a bare safe/unsafe claim: every flag GoPlus didn't return data for stays null, and the raw source data ships alongside the score.

address.description: Required. The token contract address (EVM) or mint address (Solana).

chain.description: Required. ethereum, bsc, base, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, avalanche, fantom, zksync, linea, scroll, or solana. A numeric EVM chain_id also works.

name: token_risk
